title: On an $n-$Dimensional Travel Time Tomography Problem
summary: In their seminal works Herglotz (1905) and Wiechert and Zoeppritz (1907) have solved the so-called Travel Time Tomography Problem (TTTP) in the 1-D case. However, the question about stability estimates and uniqueness theorems for an n-D n>= 2 TTTP with formally determined incomplete input data still mostly stands open after more than one hundred years period. \textquotedblleft Formally determined input data" means that the number p of free variables in the input data equals the number $n$ of free variables in the unknown right hand side of the governing nonliniear eikonal PDE, p=n.
